title: Siege of Porto
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Porto", at revision 1382315939, opens: "The siege of Porto is considered the period between July 1832 and August 1833 in which the troops of Dom Pedro remained besieged by the forces of Dom Miguel I of Portugal." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3037792, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1832 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
